modules.module_title: Fundamental for IoT for Home Automation — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: • Assess and identify the customer requirements for the installation of automated devices (e.g. smart • lighting, smart security system for doors, smart plugs, smart entertainment system, smart thermostat, • smart sensors for garden, smart sensors for toilet etc.) at customer home
Collect the necessary tools and equipment required for installation and repairing work
Check the functionality of tools and equipment before use
• Select the center hub or controller such as customer smartphone to control the smart devices as per • the customer preference
• Select and arrange the required wires, cables, sensors, lighting system and automated systems need • to install
• Check the smart devices specifications and ensure that all supporting accessories purchased are • available in the pack
• Check the availability of wi-fi connection at the customer premises and ensure that its speed is • enough for running all the smart devices smoothly and properly
• Plan for the installation process by considering factors such as device placement, wiring • requirements, and network connectivity
Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) for specific tasks and work conditions
Coordinate with the relevant personnel incase of any issues in the installation
Determine and mark the ideal locations for fixing or placing the smart devices and sensors
• Ensure nearest access to power outlets and internet connectivity for connecting the smart devices • and sensors
• Take measurements and fix or route the wires in customer premises for connecting the smart devices • and sensors with the power plugs
• Fix lighting systems in the customer premises on the marked places in customer premises by following • the SOP and manufacturer manual
• Fix smart door bell, video camera and door lock at the door by following the SOP and manufacturer • manual
• Fix CCTV cameras and other surveillance systems for home by following the SOP and manufacturer • manual
• Fix smart systems and sensors in kitchen, bathroom, garden etc. as per the customer requirement by • following the SOP and manufacturer manual
Connect all systems and sensors in the power plug and switch on the power
• Install the smart devices applications in the center hub or customer smartphone and connect the • smart devices with customer’s phone
• Configure the settings, preferences, and automation routines according to customer requirements in • the smart application
• Test each device and system to ensure proper functionality and verify that all devices respond • correctly to commands, test automation scenarios, and troubleshoot issues after the installation
• Demonstrate and explain the various functions, features and settings of smart devices and use of • control panel to the customer
Demonstrate how to operate and monitor the functioning of smart devices through application
• Guide the customer on day-to-day care activities and precautions while using the smart devices as • mentioned in product manual
prepare and maintain the records and documents related to installation work done
Enquire about the problems/unusual conditions noticed on the smart devices from the customer
• Use the smart feature app installed in customer’s smartphone to diagnose the issues in the smart • devices by following instructions in manufacturer manual
Carry out troubleshooting activities to identify the faults and faulty component in the smart devices
• Unplug the unit, carry out basic tests such as power supply inspection, volt ampere test and earth test • power supply etc. as per the instructions in manufacturer manual and SOP
• Remove the faulty component for carrying out repair or replacement after disconnecting it from • power supply
• Repair the fault at customer premises if possible or send the device to service center for repairing or • replacement, if the problem cannot be serviced onsite
• Test the functionality of device and system and verify that it is now responding correctly to • commands and test automation scenarios after repairing
Prepare and record the details related to troubleshooting and repairing of device
